# <span id="aanchor9"></span> Add a Report

Custom reports can be developed using Crystal Reports, either in-house or by Quorum on request. After a custom report has been created, you can add it to FLOWCAL so that it is available from the Standard Reports menu and from the Report Scheduler.

<div class="procedure">

To add a custom report to FLOWCAL:

1.  Go to the **Crystal** folder in the FLOWCAL installation folder. Create a folder called "Custom" if one does not already exist.
2.  Copy your report (**.rpt**) file into the **Crystal\Custom** directory.
3.  Repeat steps 1 and 2 everywhere FLOWCAL is installed.
4.  In FLOWCAL, go to **Reports** \> **Add Report** to launch the Available Reports screen. The list of available reports will only contain reports that are in the Crystal\Custom directory and that have not been previously added to FLOWCAL.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 358;height: 359;" />

1.  Select the new report and click **OK**. The Add Reports screen will display.

    If the custom report uses any parameters that are not recognized by FLOWCAL, you will be prompted to specify what the parameter should be used for. If you are developing a custom report, contact <a href="mailto:flowcal.support@quorumsoftware.com" class="notelink">Customer Support</a> for a list or supported report parameters.

2.  Select the orientation of your report (portrait or landscape).

3.  Select the menu group (report category). This is where the report will be listed in the Standard Reports screen. (See: [Report Categories](Report%20Categories.md))

4.  Select the report type, or fluid phase (Gas, Liquid, or Both). This will determine which icon displays next to the report name in the Standard Reports screen.

5.  Select the access scope:
    - **Public** – All users have access
    - **Admin Only** – Only users with **Report Scheduler** privileges have access
    - **Customize** – A user-defined combination of users/groups have access

6.  Click **OK**. The report will now be available from the Standard Reports screen and the Reports Scheduling screen.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 354;height: 299;" />

</div>
